RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel and differing credentials can suggest potential affinity bias or systemic lack of diversity, but they do not prove unlawful discrimination on their own. Municipal leadership appointments often weight political acumen, public consultation skills, interview performance, and internal alignment heavily over formal qualifications.

Whether to raise it depends on your goal. If you are preparing a formal grievance, freedom-of-information inquiry, or legal challenge, panel composition and the delayed response are relevant evidence to include. However, accusing the hiring team of bias directly during informal communications risks burning professional bridges. 

Follow up on your debrief request first. If they fail to provide objective scoring criteria, consult an employment lawyer before raising discrimination.
